title_sq: Tek Stacioni Trenit, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2, Mundesi Ideale Per Ndarje!!
description_sq: Tek Stacioni i Trenit, ne Kompleksin Usluga, shitet apartament 3+1+2, me planimetri perfekte, si dhe mundesi ideale per ndarje. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 11 te kompleksit, shume prane bulevardit Zogu I Pare dhe buze unazes, i mire administruar dhe i pajisur me ashensor. Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 160 m2 dhe organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje te bollshem bashke me kendin e gatimit, korridori qe ben shperndarjen e ambienteve, tre dhoma gjumi, dy tualete, nje ballkon. Eshte i orientuar drejt Perendimit. Vendodhja strategjike me dalje ne unazen e vogel dhe vetem 5 minuta larg qendres, e kthen ne nje nga pronat me te kerkuara si per nje jetese komode por edhe per nje investim te sigurte duke qene se apartamenti lihet me qira te larte dhe zona ka shume kerkesa per shkak te faciliteteve te shumta qe ofron si Universitete, Shkolla, Kopshte, Banka, Farmaci, Supermarkete, Ambjente Clodhese, Restorante, Bare, Linja Transporti Publik etj. Mos nguroni te beni tuajin kete apartament me pamje fantastike te Tiranes. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: Near the Train Station, 3+1+2 Apartment for Sale, Ideal Opportunity for Sharing!!
description_en: At the Train Station, in the Usluga Complex, a 3+1+2 apartment is for sale, with a perfect floor plan, as well as the ideal possibility for sharing. The apartment is located on the 11th floor of the complex, very close to Zogu I Pare boulevard and the edge of the ring road, well managed and equipped with an elevator. The apartment has a total area of ​​160 m2 and is organized in a spacious living room with a kitchen area, a corridor that distributes the premises, three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a balcony. It is oriented towards the West. The strategic location with an exit to the small ring road and only 5 minutes from the center, turns it into one of the most sought-after properties for a comfortable lifestyle but also for a safe investment, since the apartment is rented at a high rent and the area has many demands due to the many facilities it offers such as Universities, Schools, Kindergartens, Banks, Pharmacies, Supermarkets, Clothing Facilities, Restaurants, Bars, Public Transport Lines, etc. Do not hesitate to make this apartment with a fantastic view of Tirana yours. The property has full mortgage documentation.
